Dashboard Module UI

Source: R/modul_dashboard.R
dashboardUI.Rd

Creates the Shiny UI for the coder dashboard, displaying personal coding progress, training reliability trends, open-case breakdowns, and an interactive scale directory.

Usage

dashboardUI(
  id,
  kategorie_spalten = NULL,
  lang = "en",
  selected_tab = "tab_progress"
)

Arguments

id

Character string specifying the Shiny module namespace identifier.

kategorie_spalten

Optional character vector of scale column names retained for backward compatibility.

lang

Character string specifying the initial UI language code ("en" or "de").

selected_tab

Character string selecting the initially active tab ("tab_progress" or "tab_scales_overview").

Value

A shiny.tag (fluidPage) representing the dashboard interface.

Examples

if (interactive()) {
  ui <- dashboardUI("mod_dashboard", lang = "en")
}
